short_description: Comprehensive behavioral health technology company offering a portfolio of EHR, billing, and practice management solutions for mental health organizations of all sizes.
long_description: Ensora Health (formerly Therapy Brands) is a behavioral health technology company backed by KKR private equity that has consolidated multiple mental health software products into a comprehensive portfolio. Rebranded from Therapy Brands in 2024, Ensora Health offers solutions spanning solo practitioners to large enterprise organizations. The portfolio includes products like Procentive for community mental health, MyClientsPlus for private practice, ShareNote for group practices, NPAWorks for ABA therapy, Fusion for school-based services, and Catalyst for child and family services. Through acquisitions and organic development, Ensora provides clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, telehealth, outcome measurement, and revenue cycle management across its product lines. The company positions itself as a one-stop shop for behavioral health technology, offering migration paths as practices grow. Ensora Health serves mental health, substance abuse, ABA therapy, and other behavioral health specialties, making it one of the largest behavioral health technology providers by breadth of products.

faqs.a: Therapy Brands rebranded to Ensora Health in 2024. The company continues to offer the same portfolio of behavioral health software products under the new name, backed by KKR private equity.

faqs.q: What products does Ensora Health offer?
faqs.a: Ensora Health's portfolio includes Procentive (community mental health), MyClientsPlus (private practice), ShareNote (group practices), NPAWorks (ABA therapy), Fusion (school-based), WebABA (ABA), Catalyst, and other specialized products.

faqs.q: How much does Ensora Health cost?
faqs.a: Pricing varies by product within the Ensora portfolio. Solo practice products like MyClientsPlus start around $29-$49/month. Enterprise products like Procentive have custom pricing. Contact Ensora for specific quotes.

faqs.q: Is Ensora Health good for ABA therapy?
faqs.a: Yes, Ensora offers NPAWorks and WebABA specifically designed for ABA therapy practices with features for insurance billing, data collection, and practice management unique to ABA.
